notes.title: Patch 1.0.3
notes.notes:
We updated some menus and icons for the Steam Deck as we are working towards getting the game verified :

[list]
[*]The resolution dropdown list can now be scrolled with a controller.
[*]The button icons are a bit bigger and bolder, so they are easier to read.
[*]Some words have been changed to better reflect if you are playing with a controller or mouse/keyboard.
[/list]
Enjoy!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.notes:
We updated motion sickness settings and functionality : 

[list]
[*]The tilting setting can now completely disable the tilting effect. We also updated the slider values because it was a bit confusing to set up for players.
[*]We added a new setting named “Stick to surfaces”. The setting prevents the fly avatar from sticking to anything, so you can no longer be disoriented by crawling upside down, for example. This feature can impact immersion or game experience, so it needs to be activated manually in the settings menu.
[/list]
Thanks for your feedback!

notes.title: Meal time!
notes.notes:
After 3 years of sweaty game development by Jonathan and I, the game has finally launched!

[previewyoutube=Iatx2bttQm0;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Polished surreal experience freshly out of the oven[/h2]
[list]
[*]You are the fly. Play as the dirty, filthy, corpse-eating fly on a mission to devour a monster living in a bath in a house far away. 
[*]Meet depressing caterpillars along with other surreal characters. 
[*]Restart the grotesque tale and choose a different path through the story, eating your way to three different endings.
[*]Taste it here : [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2107180/The_Hungry_Fly/] [b]Steam page[/b][/url]
[/list]
The best way to support the game is to [b]leave a review on Steam[/b]. It helps more than you think! 

We will be updating the game actively, so don’t hesitate to send us any feedback and bugs you encounter. You can reach us on [url=https://discord.gg/5xaS3bGfHd]Discord[/url].

We hope you’ll find the game meaningful in some way!


- François and Jonathan

notes.title: Official Publisher Announcement
notes.notes:
We made the game we dreamed of making. Now we want to bring it to you. 

To make this happen, we’ve partnered with [b]indie.io[/b]. They are a publishing platform dedicated to indie creators. With their help, we’ll be able to reach our weird players and polish the game!

They help us in many ways such as : 
[list]
[*] Access to events
[*] Plan marketing campaign
[*] Contact the press for big announcements
[*] Quality assurance
[*] Letting us focus on finishing the last touches to the game
[/list]
The most important thing is that they will help us bring The Hungry Fly to more people. They have already done so with many other titles. Partnering with them will help us bring more grotesqueness in people’s lives and that’s what we’re all about!

Thanks a lot for your interest in our game! 

Don’t forget to [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2107180/The_Hungry_Fly/]wishlist the game[/url][/b] and join our [url=discord.gg/5xaS3bGfHd]Discord community[/url] to be notified of future announcements!

You can also check some of the other great indie titles Indie.io is helping to promote on their [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/indieio]Steam publisher page[/url].

notes.title: New localisation
notes.notes:
Hey! 

We just made an important update on the demo. 
You will find bug fixes, visual improvements (in the UI and the fonts) and more importantly, you will find 2 new languages : French and Japanese. I translated the game in French since it’s my native language. msBean offered to translate in Japanese. THANKS! 

Jonathan reached out to msBean to send the demo because we noticed the beta demo had already been played on the msBean twitch channel. They chatted a bit about Japanese food and stuff, and here we are! Translating in Japanese was a project we’ve had for a long time, but we delayed it many times. Thanks for the kick in the butt! If you’re curious, msBean has a Twitch [url=https://www.twitch.tv/ms8ean]https://www.twitch.tv/ms8ean[/url] and a Youtube channel [url=https://www.youtube.com/msBean]https://www.youtube.com/msBean[/url] 

We believe Japanese people might be interested in The Hungry Fly because of the game concept itself and because we had some Japanese press coverage when we announced the game. 
4gamer : [url=https://www.4gamer.net/games/654/G065495/20220902148/]https://www.4gamer.net/games/654/G065495/20220902148/[/url] 
gamespark : [url=https://www.gamespark.jp/article/2022/09/03/121971.html ]https://www.gamespark.jp/article/2022/09/03/121971.html [/url]
It’s very weird because we did not send anything to them, we did not write anything in Japanese. Some people found an obscure game announcement and thought it was worth translating the news. Often, to get coverage, the publisher (or the dev if you self-publish) has to contact the press to get coverage. 

In the end, the only way to really know if Japanese people will like it or not is to make it available to them. We’ll see!

Anyway, the game looks badass in Japanese!

François

notes.title: Demo is out now!
notes.notes:
Hey folks!

The demo is finally out!

It features : 
[list]
[*] Anti-sickness options so people who are sensitive to motion sickness can now also enjoy the game.
[*] A “run” button that lets you fly faster. 
[*] A new level
[*] The saddest caterpillar ever!
[*] New mechanics
[*] Bug fixes (thanks for your feedback!)
[/list]

[previewyoutube=trbWZ0XYauM;leftthumb][/previewyoutube] 

Note that the demo is not the beginning of the game. It starts with a “demo exclusive” level. Then, you reach a level that comes “somewhere later in the game”. This way, you should get a good idea of the direction we are going for the whole game.

Development update
The core mechanics are pretty much all complete. We are mainly working on the level design. We’ve also improved the content of the game intro that some of you tried earlier this year. You can discover that at the full release! ;) 

IMPORTANT : 
We truly value your feedback. If you encounter any gameplay problems, bugs, or you want to say hi, reach out to Jonathan or me (François) on Discord : https://discord.gg/5xaS3bGfHd 

François

notes.title: Release delay and new demo
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

The title says it all. We have two pieces of news: we have to delay the game release, but in the meantime, we will release a new demo of The Hungry Fly.

Why this delay? 
We realized we could not meet the 2023 deadline and get the quality we want. We prefer to delay the release instead of cutting too much content. Levels are very different from each other, so it takes a lot of time to develop, more than we thought. We underestimated the challenges this development takes. We think waiting is worth it.

We don’t want to promise a release date for now. Obviously, we already have some ideas, but we’ll wait before announcing any date so we are sure we can keep our promise this time. 

I hope you will understand that this decision has been made for the game. We are working hard. After 2 years of development, we are too passionate to see the game be cut or released unpolished. 

The demo
The good news is that we will release a new demo! The content is completely different from the first demo. It will also feature some improvements based on your feedback and all the streaming we’ve watched (a lot). This demo is closer to what the final game is. 

The demo release date will be revealed VERY soon.

notes.title: Demo ending
notes.notes:
Alas, as previously mentioned, the end of the demo has come! Letting all of you play a glimpse of the game is really helping us make a better game. We took a lot of notes, watched a lot of videos, and communicated with a lot of wonderful people. It was a pleasure to see you enjoy it!

Now it’s time to go back to development and finish this game. If you want updates on the game, join our Discord https://discord.gg/5xaS3bGfHd or follow us on Twitter @EruptingAvocado Stay alert, we never know when another demo could show itself. Thank you all for playing! See you soon.

notes.title: Demo is out!
notes.notes:
After more than a year of development, the first demo is out! 

This release marks only the beginning, yet it still feels like a long time ago that we started this project. 

It started with “it would be cool if we could embody a fly eating rotting flesh”, and it’s now a dark tale with a very personal story. 

With The Hungry Fly, we wanted to try a new approach to development. When making our first game The Repairing Mantis, I tried to stick completely to the initial vision I’ve had of the game, and integrate nothing else, so the experience would be as “pure” as possible. In other words, I got rid of everything that didn’t evoke some very specific emotions. Was it really necessary to make an interesting game? 

I thought it did. Then, I saw this incredible puppet show : Body Concert by the Lone Wolf Tribe. After the show, I had the chance to hear the artist talk about his work. That show took many years to make. Yet, the director gave himself the permission to change his mind during the whole creation process. As a result, the project contains a very broad range of emotions (fun, sad, cute…). The experience is still coherent, and has a lot of nuances. 

The show really inspired me to stop fighting new ideas that come through development. It’s ok if some things disappear. It gives place to new ones. I am curious about how the game will turn out. 

TLDR : We worked hard with passion and we are now ready to hear your feedback so we can improve the game. 

To send feedback, we are mainly on Discord https://discord.com/invite/5xaS3bGfHd but you can also write to us on Twitter @EruptingAvocado

Note that the demo will no longer be accessible after the Steam Next Fest (February 13th), because it may no longer reflect the game’s quality. We might put back an updated version later, but we don’t promise anything for now, so play it soon if you want to try it. :) 

Thanks for your interest in our game.
